# ViraStack (full)

> DX-first open-source toolkit for React frontend developers. Headless utilities (no forced CSS/DOM), React-first packages, independent `@virastack/*` modules, and agent-ready scaffolds. MIT.

This file is a self-contained overview for LLMs. For the deepest API detail, prefer each product’s `llms-full.txt`.

## Positioning

- Fills small, painful frontend gaps, not TanStack-scale data/query verticals
- Packages are headless: logic and props only; style with shadcn, Base UI, Ant Design, or plain HTML
- Packages are independent: installing Mask does not require Password or AI
- Primary documentation language: English (site is i18n; APIs and package docs center on EN)

## Products & install

| Product | Install / entry | npm |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Start | `npx virastack@latest` | `virastack` (~1.1.0) |
| AI | `npx @virastack/ai init` | `@virastack/ai` (~2.0.0) |
| Mask | `npm i @virastack/mask` | `@virastack/mask` (~2.1.0) |
| Password | `npm i @virastack/password` | `@virastack/password` (1.1.x) |
| Address | `npm i @virastack/address` | `@virastack/address` (1.0.x) |
| Academy | https://virastack.com/academy | free curriculum (not an npm lib) |
| Guide | https://virastack.com/guide/play | site experience (not an npm lib) |

## Start (quick)

```bash
npx virastack@latest init my-app --template nextjs --agent claude,cursor --tools mask,password --yes
```

Flags: `init [name]`, `add <tool>`, `--template nextjs|tanstack`, `--agent claude,cursor|none`, `--tools mask,password,address`, `--i18n` / `--no-i18n`, `--yes`, `--skip-install`, `--tr`, `--telemetry-disable`.

Templates ship a feature-based layout, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS 4, TanStack Query, Zustand, nuqs, RHF + Zod, Base UI, Vitest + MSW tests, ViraStack AI rules and three design skills. Details: https://virastack.com/start/llms-full.txt

## AI (quick)

```bash
npx @virastack/ai init
# optional: --agent claude,cursor|none, --dry-run, --force, --framework nextjs|tanstack, --tr
npx @virastack/ai remove
```

Detects Next.js vs TanStack Start from `package.json`. Writes rules to `.claude/rules/virastack/` and `.cursor/rules/virastack/`, a managed block in `AGENTS.md`, an `@AGENTS.md` line in `CLAUDE.md` and a `.virastack/ai.json` manifest. v1 guide (archived): https://virastack.com/ai/v1/llms-full.txt. Details: https://virastack.com/ai/llms-full.txt

## Mask (quick)

Peers: `react` ≥ 18.2, `react-hook-form` ≥ 7.55. The form stores **raw** values; inputs show **masked** text. Spread the returned object as is (no `rawValue` in v2).

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form"
import { useViraMask } from "@virastack/mask"

const form = useForm<{ phone: string; card: string; cvv: string }>()
const { phone, card, cvv } = useViraMask(form, {
  phone: { preset: "phone", country: "TR" },
  card: "card",
  cvv: { preset: "cvv", from: "card" },
})
return <input {...phone} />
```

Presets: `phone`, `iban`, `currency`, `number` (all take `country: "TR"` for the Turkish layout), `card`, `cvv`, `expiry`, `tckn`, `vkn`, `date`. Errors are keys (`tckn.invalid`). With Zod/Valibot: `resolver: maskResolver(masks, zodResolver(schema))`. Server: `parseMasked(masks, formData, schema?)` from `@virastack/mask/server`.

Details: https://virastack.com/mask/llms-full.txt

## Password (quick)

Peers: `react`, `react-dom` (≥18.2). One hook for the field: show/hide, NIST-style strength (`/strength`), confirmation (`matchWith`), the same policy on the server (`/server`) and an optional Have I Been Pwned check (`/pwned`). Errors are keys. Not a UI component.

```tsx
import { useViraPassword } from "@virastack/password"
import { definePolicy } from "@virastack/password/strength"

const policy = definePolicy() // NIST: 15–64 characters

const { inputProps, btnProps, strength, issues } = useViraPassword({ policy })
return (
  <>
    <input {...inputProps} />
    <button {...btnProps} />
    <p>{strength?.level}</p>
  </>
)
```

Server: `validatePassword(formData.get("password"), policy, { forbidden: [email], confirm })`. Details: https://virastack.com/password/llms-full.txt

## Address (quick)

Peer: `react` ≥ 18.2. Headless Turkish address hook: chained il → ilçe → mahalle selects, derived postal code (or fill the selects from a typed code), server validation (`@virastack/address/server`) and the bundled PTT dataset (`/data`, 81 provinces, 973 districts, 72,466 neighbourhoods). Pass `form` for React Hook Form.

```tsx
import { useViraAddress } from "@virastack/address"

const { getProvinceProps, getDistrictProps, getNeighbourhoodProps, value } = useViraAddress({ form })
return (
  <>
    <select {...getProvinceProps()} />
    <select {...getDistrictProps()} />
    <select {...getNeighbourhoodProps()} />
  </>
)
```

Server: `await resolveAddress({ province, district, neighbourhood, postalCode })`. Details: https://virastack.com/address/llms-full.txt

## Academy (quick)

Free, open-source frontend curriculum in Turkish and English. Lesson map: https://virastack.com/academy/llms.txt

## Guide (quick)

Interactive path from plain content → modern stack → Tailwind → typography → components (incl. Mask/Password demos) → theme → AI prompt UI → ViraStack ecosystem CTA. Play: https://virastack.com/guide/play; full: https://virastack.com/guide/llms-full.txt
